stock.description: Ruichang International Holdings Limited, a company based in the People's Republic of China, specializes in producing and distributing machinery for the petroleum refining and petrochemical sectors. Its comprehensive product line includes sulfur recovery units (SRU), systems for incinerating volatile organic compounds (VOCs), catalytic cracking apparatus, industrial process burners, and various heat exchange equipment. Beyond manufacturing, the firm also delivers a range of services such as installation, electrical and mechanical construction, and expert technology consulting. Established in 1994, Ruichang International operates from its main office located in Shanghai, China.
